issues.description: Missing file header: conanfile.py must start with a shebang (#!/usr/bin/env python3) and a docstring describing the software name and build system (e.g. """Conan recipe — glproto 1.4.17 (Autotools)"""). The file currently starts directly with an import statement.

Template placeholder residue: url = "" with comment '# CI fills this' is explicitly listed as a forbidden template placeholder in code-style rule 5. The adapter should fill in the recipe hosting URL before submitting. An empty url field indicates incomplete work.
issues.fix_suggestion:
Fill in the url field with the actual recipe hosting location, or remove the field if the project does not use it. For example:
    url = "https://cnb.cool/your-org/your-repo/-/tree/main/archives/g/glproto/1.4.17"

issues.description: Field name mismatch: manifest.yaml uses 'software:' as the top-level key, but code-style rule 14 specifies the field should be named 'name:' (e.g. name: glproto).
issues.fix_suggestion:
Rename the field from 'software' to 'name':
name: glproto

issues.description: Version value not quoted: code-style rule 14 requires the version field to be quoted as version: "1.4.17" (string with double quotes). The current value version: 1.4.17 is unquoted, which YAML may interpret as a floating-point number.
issues.fix_suggestion:
Add double quotes around the version value:
version: "1.4.17"

issues.description: patch_description format deviation: code-style rule 12 expects patch_description to follow the format '序号 描述' (4-digit patch number prefix followed by space-separated description, e.g. "0001 Add HarmonyOS platform recognition to config.guess"). The current value "Add HarmonyOS platform recognition to config.guess" is missing the '0001' number prefix.
issues.fix_suggestion:
Prepend the patch number to the description:
    patch_description: "0001 Add HarmonyOS platform recognition to config.guess"

issues.description: patch_description format deviation: same as above for the second patch. The description "Remove umask 077 from config.status temp directory creation (HarmonyOS HMDFS fix)" is missing the '0002' number prefix expected by code-style rule 12.
issues.fix_suggestion:
Prepend the patch number to the description:
    patch_description: "0002 Remove umask 077 from config.status temp directory creation (HarmonyOS HMDFS fix)"

issues.description: Documentation inaccuracy: notes.md describes the umask 077 fix as a 'programmatic fix in conanfile.py build() method at runtime' (Section '### conanfile.py build() 中的程序化修复'), but the actual conanfile.py build() method does NOT perform any runtime modification of configure. The fix is applied via the patch file 0002-configure-fix-umask-077.patch through apply_conandata_patches(). The notes.md problem table (row 2) also claims the solution is 'Python replace in build()'. This documentation does not match the actual implementation.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update notes.md to accurately describe the fix as a patch-based approach. Replace the '程序化修复' section heading with '### 0002-configure-fix-umask-077.patch' and describe it as a patch that removes umask 077 from the configure script. Update the problem table row 2 solution column to: '通过 0002-configure-fix-umask-077.patch 补丁移除 umask 077'.

issues.description: Unused import: 'import os' is imported but only referenced in a commented-out alternative code path (line: '# self.run(f"{os.path.join(...)}")'). The import is not used in any active code path.
issues.fix_suggestion: Either remove the unused 'import os' line, or uncomment the alternative test execution path if it is intended to be used.

summary:
Audit of glproto 1.4.17 Conan recipe (branch feat/glproto-1.4.17) completed. VERDICT: PASS.

P0 (Deception Detection) — No issues found. The test_package/test.c includes <GL/glxtokens.h> and performs real assertions checking GLX_RGBA==4 and GLX_DOUBLEBUFFER==5, which is a legitimate test for a header-only protocol package (R34 pass). test_package/conanfile.py executes cmake.test() without skipping or faking (R9 pass). manifest.yaml status='built' is consistent with notes.md 'final status: built' and represents verified-but-not-published (status consistency pass). sha256 '9d8130fec2b98bd032db7730fa092dd9dec39f3de34f4bb03ceb43b9903dbc96' is 64 hex characters, not all-zeros or all-f (sha256 validity pass). No #ifdef __OHOS__ stubs present (R8 N/A). No precompiled binaries in PR (R19 pass). glproto is a header-only X.Org protocol package — no graphics rendering adaptation required (R40 N/A).

P1 (Recipe Correctness) — No issues found. No hardcoded local paths. No runtime modification of generated files (the umask fix is handled via patch 0002, not runtime Python replace). patches_applied in manifest.yaml matches conandata.yml patches and actual patch files. Source URL is official freedesktop.org archive (R39 pass). Conan 2.x API used correctly (R16 pass). No commands.json needed for header-only library (R38 N/A).

P2 (Code Conventions) — 6 warnings: conanfile.py missing shebang+docstring header (CS-1); conanfile.py has template placeholder 'url = ""  # CI fills this' (CS-5); manifest.yaml uses 'software' instead of 'name' field (CS-14); manifest.yaml version not quoted (CS-14); two conandata.yml patch_description entries missing 4-digit number prefix (CS-12).

P3 (Suggestions) — 2 hints: notes.md inaccurately describes umask fix as runtime programmatic modification when it is actually patch-based (DOC-1); test_package/conanfile.py has unused 'import os' (CS-16).
